stage_definitions.vi_label: Thể cấp tính / Sưng đỏ / Rỉ dịch ướt
stage_definitions.description: Giai đoạn khởi phát hoặc đợt bùng phát cấp tính với ban đỏ rực, phù nề, mụn nước, bọng nước hoặc rỉ dịch huyết thanh ẩm ướt.

stage_definitions.vi_label: Thể bán cấp / Se mặt / Đóng vảy tiết (mài)
stage_definitions.description: Giai đoạn chuyển tiếp bán cấp khi mụn nước vỡ se mặt, đóng mài vàng/nâu hoặc bong vảy mỏng trên nền hồng ban.

stage_definitions.vi_label: Thể mạn tính / Khô ráp / Bong vảy dày / Dày sừng
stage_definitions.description: Giai đoạn tiến triển mạn tính với da khô ráp, bong vảy dày, dày sừng, liken hóa hằn cổ trâu hoặc biến đổi sắc tố dai dẳng.

stage_definitions.vi_label: Thể cào xước, loét thứ phát & Dấu hiệu phân biệt vị trí
stage_definitions.description: Tổn thương biến đổi do cào gãi trầy xước, nứt nẻ, trợt loét, bội nhiễm kèm vị trí giải phẫu điển hình giúp phân biệt chẩn đoán.

Unknown_Normal.vi_name: Da bình thường / Không tổn thương đặc hiệu

stages.acute_wet: clinical photograph of normal healthy human skin with smooth intact epidermis and uniform physiological skin tone without rash
stages.subacute_crust: unremarkable healthy skin surface showing normal pores, fine skin lines, and absence of erythema, crust, or scaling
stages.chronic_dry: clear normal cutaneous surface with intact barrier, slightly dry physiological texture but no pathological plaque or tumor
stages.secondary_diff: normal anatomical skin region on face, trunk, or limbs without dermatological disease, ulceration, or inflammation

Benign_tumors.vi_name: U da lành tính (Nang thượng bì, U xơ bì, U mỡ)

stages.acute_wet: clinical photograph of an inflamed benign cutaneous cyst or benign skin nodule with smooth dome-shaped flesh-colored surface
stages.subacute_crust: well-circumscribed benign epidermal inclusion cyst with central punctum or soft pedunculated acrochordons skin tags
stages.chronic_dry: firm hyperpigmented dimpled dermatofibroma nodule or slow-growing subcutaneous lipoma with intact overlying skin
stages.secondary_diff: solitary symmetrical non-malignant skin growth or sebaceous hyperplasia papule with regular borders and no invasive ulceration

stages.acute_wet: acute weeping eczematous dermatitis with intensely pruritic erythematous patches, clustered microvesicles, and serous oozing exudate
stages.subacute_crust: subacute eczema showing erythematous papules and plaques with yellowish serous crusting, flaking, and partially healed erosions
stages.chronic_dry: chronic atopic dermatitis with dry thickened lichenified skin plaques, accentuated skin markings, hyperkeratosis, and xerosis
stages.secondary_diff: excoriated itchy eczematous rash in flexural creases, hands, or neck with linear scratch marks, painful fissures, and impetiginized crust

Tinea.vi_name: Nấm da nông (Hắc lào / Nấm thân / Nấm chân)

stages.acute_wet: acute inflammatory dermatophyte tinea infection with erythematous vesicular advancing border and moist interdigital maceration
stages.subacute_crust: annular ringworm tinea corporis plaque with active raised scaly erythematous edge and paler central clearing
stages.chronic_dry: chronic moccasin-type tinea pedis or tinea cruris showing diffuse dry powdery scaling, hyperkeratosis, and well-defined margin
stages.secondary_diff: pruritic superficial fungal skin infection with concentric scaly rings, scratched border, or tinea incognito on trunk, groin, or feet

stages.acute_wet: acute guttate or pustular psoriasis flare with bright salmon-red drop-like papules and sterile pustules on erythematous skin
stages.subacute_crust: developing psoriatic plaques with sharply demarcated erythematous base and adherent micaceous flaky scales
stages.chronic_dry: chronic plaque psoriasis vulgaris featuring thick silvery-white layered hyperkeratotic scales over well-circumscribed red plaques
stages.secondary_diff: psoriatic lesions on extensor elbows, knees, scalp, or nails with pinpoint Auspitz bleeding spots after scratching off scales

stages.acute_wet: erythematous inflamed actinic keratosis macule with tender red base and thin fragile surface on sun-exposed skin
stages.subacute_crust: solar keratosis lesion covered by adherent rough yellow-brown keratotic crust and gritty sandpaper-like scale
stages.chronic_dry: chronic hyperkeratotic actinic keratosis or cutaneous horn with hard dry thick adherent scale on chronically photodamaged skin
stages.secondary_diff: multiple rough scaly premalignant solar keratoses on bald scalp, forehead, nose, ears, or dorsal forearms of fair photoaged skin

stages.acute_wet: early progressing vitiligo showing hypopigmented trichrome macules transitioning into chalk-white amelanotic skin patches
stages.subacute_crust: sharply demarcated milky-white depigmented skin patches with smooth non-scaly intact epidermis
stages.chronic_dry: long-standing stable vitiligo with complete loss of melanin pigment, convex hyperpigmented borders, and white leukotrichia hairs
stages.secondary_diff: symmetrical autoimmune depigmented white patches around eyes, mouth, fingers, wrists, or knees occasionally with mild pink sunburn erythema

stages.acute_wet: ulcerated bleeding malignant skin tumor or nodular basal cell carcinoma with translucent pearly rolled border and surface oozing
stages.subacute_crust: invasive squamous cell carcinoma or rodent ulcer presenting as indurated erythematous nodule with central hemorrhagic crust
stages.chronic_dry: malignant melanoma or keratotic cutaneous carcinoma showing asymmetry, irregular notched borders, variegated black-brown-pink colors, and hyperkeratosis
stages.secondary_diff: destructive non-healing friable skin malignancy with arborizing telangiectasia, central crateriform ulceration, and crusted necrotic eschar

stages.acute_wet: acute inflammatory acne breakout with tender erythematous papules, yellow-headed pustules, and deep fluctuant nodulocystic lesions
stages.subacute_crust: papulopustular acne vulgaris with ruptured crusted pimples, open blackhead comedones, and closed whitehead comedones
stages.chronic_dry: persistent comedonal and post-inflammatory acne showing sebaceous follicular plugging, post-acne erythema, and hyperpigmented macules
stages.secondary_diff: excoriated acne on face, jawline, chest, or upper back with picked crusted lesions, icepick or boxcar atrophic acne scars

stages.acute_wet: clusters of moist filiform or macerated viral HPV warts and condylomatous papillomas with fleshy finger-like projections
stages.subacute_crust: verruca vulgaris papule with rough pebble-like papillomatous surface and tiny black dots of thrombosed capillaries
stages.chronic_dry: thick hyperkeratotic plantar wart or chronic flat verruca plana with firm calloused collar and dry verrucous surface
stages.secondary_diff: periungual or palmar viral warts on fingers, hands, or soles showing fissured rough keratotic surface after paring or scratching

Lichen.vi_name: Lichen phẳng / Lichen đơn mạn tính

stages.acute_wet: eruptive cutaneous lichen planus with shiny violaceous purple flat-topped polygonal papules and intense pruritus
stages.subacute_crust: violaceous lichenoid plaques displaying fine lacy white Wickham striae and adherent thin whitish scale
stages.chronic_dry: hypertrophic lichen planus or lichen simplex chronicus with thick leathery hyperkeratotic brownish-purple plaques
stages.secondary_diff: excoriated pruritic lichenoid lesions on flexor wrists, shins, ankles, or oral mucosa with linear Koebner scratch phenomenon and post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation

DrugEruption.vi_name: Phát ban da do dị ứng thuốc

stages.acute_wet: acute widespread morbilliform exanthematous drug eruption with bright confluent erythematous macules, papules, or blistering reaction
stages.subacute_crust: resolving maculopapular drug rash or dusky violaceous round fixed drug eruption plaque with central blister or crust
stages.chronic_dry: post-exanthematous desquamating drug reaction with diffuse flaky peeling skin and residual violaceous-brown hyperpigmented patch
stages.secondary_diff: symmetrical medication-induced cutaneous hypersensitivity rash across trunk and extremities with pruritic scratched erythema

Vascular_Tumors.vi_name: U máu & Dị dạng mạch máu da

stages.acute_wet: friable bright-red lobulated pyogenic granuloma vascular papule that bleeds easily with moist eroded hemorrhagic surface
stages.subacute_crust: proliferating infantile strawberry hemangioma or cherry angioma presenting as compressible crimson-red vascular nodule with focal crust
stages.chronic_dry: involuting vascular tumor, flat violaceous port-wine stain capillary malformation, or dark blue-purple venous lake on skin
stages.secondary_diff: well-demarcated blood-filled vascular cutaneous lesion with collarette of scale or superficial ulceration on head, lips, fingers, or trunk

Infestations_Bites.vi_name: Côn trùng đốt & Ghẻ ký sinh trùng

stages.acute_wet: acute arthropod insect bite reaction with edematous erythematous urticarial wheals, central punctum, or tense pruritic bullae
stages.subacute_crust: scabies infestation or papular urticaria showing clustered erythematous papules, serpiginous burrows, and pinpoint hemorrhagic crusts
stages.chronic_dry: persistent nodular scabies or chronic bite nodules with firm itchy brownish-red indurated papules and dry scaling
stages.secondary_diff: heavily excoriated scratched insect bites or interdigital web-space scabies burrows with secondary impetigo crusting

Bullous.vi_name: Bệnh da bọng nước tự miễn (Pemphigus / Pemphigoid)

stages.acute_wet: acute autoimmune bullous dermatosis featuring large tense clear or hemorrhagic fluid-filled bullae and fragile flaccid blisters
stages.subacute_crust: ruptured pemphigus or bullous pemphigoid blisters leaving raw moist bright-red denuded erosions and thick honey-brown crusts
stages.chronic_dry: healing vesiculobullous plaques with peripheral epidermal collarette peeling, dry re-epithelializing patches, and dyspigmentation
stages.secondary_diff: widespread painful crusted skin erosions and Nikolsky-positive fragile blisters on erythematous urticarial base across trunk, limbs, or oral mucosa

Vasculitis.vi_name: Viêm mạch máu ngoài da (Cutaneous Vasculitis)

stages.acute_wet: acute leukocytoclastic vasculitis flare with crops of non-blanching dark-red palpable purpura, hemorrhagic vesicles, and ankle edema
stages.subacute_crust: necrotic purpuric macules and coalescing hemorrhagic plaques covered with dark eschar and hemorrhagic crusting
stages.chronic_dry: resolving cutaneous small-vessel vasculitis leaving hemosiderin brownish-purple staining, livedo reticularis, and atrophic scars
stages.secondary_diff: gravity-dependent symmetrical palpable purpura and punched-out necrotic ulcers predominantly on lower legs and ankles

stages.acute_wet: irritated inflamed seborrheic keratosis with erythematous halo and slightly oozing friable verrucous surface after friction
stages.subacute_crust: tan to dark-brown waxy stuck-on epidermal papule or plaque with greasy keratin plugs and crumbly crusted surface
stages.chronic_dry: classic mature seborrheic keratosis showing sharply demarcated brown-black verrucous hyperkeratotic plaque with horn pseudocysts and cerebriform fissures
stages.secondary_diff: multiple benign pasted-on warty pigmented plaques on temple, face, chest, or back of older adults with dull waxy surface distinct from smooth nevus

Moles.vi_name: Nốt ruồi sắc tố lành tính (Melanocytic Nevus)

stages.acute_wet: benign halo nevus or mildly irritated junctional melanocytic nevus with symmetrical round pink-tan rim and smooth intact surface
stages.subacute_crust: compound melanocytic nevus presenting as small round evenly pigmented light-to-dark brown dome-shaped papule
stages.chronic_dry: long-standing intradermal dermal nevus appearing as soft flesh-colored or tan dome-shaped papule sometimes with terminal hairs
stages.secondary_diff: solitary small symmetrical round or oval benign mole with uniform pigment network and sharp regular borders without waxy stuck-on keratin

Sun_Sunlight_Damage.vi_name: Tổn thương da do ánh nắng (Photodamage / Solar Lentigo)

stages.acute_wet: acute UV sunburn reaction showing diffuse tender erythema, edema, and superficial sunburn blistering peeling within sun-exposed borders
stages.subacute_crust: peeling desquamating sunburned skin transitioning into mottled irregular tan-brown solar lentigines and actinic freckling
stages.chronic_dry: chronic dermatoheliosis photoaging with coarse deep rhytids wrinkles, yellowish leathery solar elastosis, and flat brown liver spots
stages.secondary_diff: poikiloderma of Civatte on lateral neck, V-chest, shoulders, and dorsal hands showing mottled brown dyspigmentation and fine telangiectasia without malar butterfly plaque or pustules

Lupus.vi_name: Lupus ban đỏ ở da (Cutaneous Lupus Erythematosus)

stages.acute_wet: acute cutaneous lupus erythematosus presenting with photosensitive edematous butterfly malar erythema across cheeks and nasal bridge while sparing nasolabial folds
stages.subacute_crust: subacute cutaneous lupus annular polycyclic or psoriasiform erythematous scaly plaques on sun-exposed upper trunk and arms
stages.chronic_dry: chronic discoid lupus erythematosus coin-shaped plaques with adherent carpet-tack follicular keratin plugs, central pale depressed atrophy, and scarring alopecia
stages.secondary_diff: autoimmune lupus skin lesions on malar cheeks, conchal bowl of ears, or scalp showing dyspigmented atrophic central scarring and violaceous active border without comedones or pustules

Rosacea.vi_name: Trứng cá đỏ / Đỏ mặt mạn tính (Rosacea)

stages.acute_wet: acute papulopustular rosacea flare with persistent bright centrofacial flushing erythema and crops of inflammatory papules and pinpoint pustules without blackheads
stages.subacute_crust: erythematotelangiectatic rosacea on convex cheeks, nose, chin, and central forehead with prominent dilated branching telangiectasia blood vessels
stages.chronic_dry: chronic phymatous rosacea and rhinophyma featuring bulbous thickened sebaceous skin, enlarged pores, and persistent redness on the nose
stages.secondary_diff: sensitive burning centrofacial redness with visible spider capillaries and acneiform pustules affecting nasolabial area and nose without follicular atrophy or scaling

Candidiasis.vi_name: Nhiễm nấm men Candida ở da (Cutaneous Candidiasis)

stages.acute_wet: acute intertriginous cutaneous candidiasis showing bright beefy-red weeping moist macerated erythema deep inside warm skin folds
stages.subacute_crust: eroded candidal intertrigo bordered by ragged peeling epidermal collarette scale and characteristic pinpoint satellite papulopustules
stages.chronic_dry: chronic candidal paronychia nail-fold swelling, angular cheilitis lip-corner fissures, or whitish curd-like Thrush pseudomembranous plaques
stages.secondary_diff: macerated itchy burning red fungal rash in axillary, inframammary, groin, or diaper folds distinguished by small discrete satellite pustules outside the main margin
